hooks.command: input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qE '"stop_hook_active"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true'; then exit 0; fi; out=$( { uv run ruff check src tests && uv run pytest -q -x; } 2>&1 ); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -25 >&2; exit 2; fi

input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qE 'rm[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|rm[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*r|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]].*(--force|-f([^a-zA-Z-]|$))|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard|git[[:space:]]+clean[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*f|DROP[[:space:]]+TABLE|Remove-Item.*-Recurse.*-Force|Remove-Item.*-Force.*-Recurse'; then echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다. 파일 삭제는 git rm 또는 Python pathlib/shutil 코드로 하라.' >&2; exit 2; fi
